last key (t=1.80s) is a 100 deg jump from the previous key in 17 ms: looks like a capture/reset pose, excluded from the key poses

manji.dummy.auto: 1.80s @60fps, 41 authored keys -> 28 key poses; 87% of the time is held (longest hold 0.88s); 1 snap bursts, median 133 ms, peak 11290 deg/s (punch x11.4 over the mean); torso travels 4.5 studs; biggest movers: ra 246 deg, rl 135 deg, t 96 deg
manji.dummy.desc: Dummy rig, 1.8s one-shot. Pure hold-snap-hold: ~0.6s of near-still anticipation (slow drift, 520 deg/s) -> ONE 0.14s snap (ra/rl/head, peak 11k deg/s, x11 the mean energy) -> 0.9s hold of the new pose with slight drift. 87% of the time is held. Torso travels 4.5 studs and accumulates ~210 deg of turn. Right arm swings 246 deg of pitch.
style: Rhythm = long hold -> 8-frame snap -> long hold; the snap carries all the energy, the holds carry the readability.
Inside the snap the lead joint travels ~16% beyond where the burst ends before coming back (overshoot).
19 of 28 key poses are linear; only the snap's last keys use InOut to soften the landing.
First/last raw keys are capture artifacts (169 deg / 100 deg jumps in 1-4 frames): the DB excludes them from `keys` but keeps them in `raw`. Never imitate them.
manji.dummy.rig_note: Standard R6 pose tree HumanoidRootPart>Torso>limbs. Raw t=0 and t=1.8s keys are capture resets.

manji.cam.name: ManjiRaw
manji.cam.auto: camera/prop rig (RootPart,Torso), 36 keys, 1.80s; pose = [x,y,z, pitch,yaw,roll deg (YXZ)]
manji.cam.desc: Camera rig (RootPart + Torso) authored as a PAIR of manji.dummy: same name 'ManjiRaw', same 1.8s length. Torso pose = [x,y,z, pitch,yaw,roll]: camera sits 4-8 studs in front (z 4.3..7.7), swings yaw +35 -> -27 deg (range -32..+48) while roll flips +11.7 -> -13.7 deg (dutch tilt) and pitch stays within +-12 deg. 36 keys, one every ~4 frames (0.067s median): coarse whip/orbit, not a smooth dolly.
style: Camera is a second KeyframeSequence with the character's length; author both on the same timeline.
Motion = yaw sweep + roll flip + small pitch drift; roll sign change gives the 'punchy' tilt.
Keys are sparse (~4 frames) - the camera does not need per-frame keys.
manji.cam.rig_note: Not an R6 character: Torso pose is [x,y,z,pitch,yaw,roll] (YXZ), RootPart stays at zero. Stored in `raw` only.

manji.yuji_start.desc: Yuji rig, 1.0s one-shot stance. Rest -> stance in 0.1s (peak 6.4k deg/s on arms+torso), then 0.9s hold with a slow creep. Torso twisted ~70 deg yaw with the head counter-rotated ~55 deg to keep the gaze forward; both arms raised ~100 deg pitch with different roll; one knee lifted (ll 75 deg) vs the other leg almost straight (rl 19 deg). All 9 transitions are linear.
style: Instant stance snap (6 frames) then a LIVING hold: every hold key moves ~3-4 deg (median over the hold) (e.g. ra pitch 99.8 -> 102.6 -> 105.6 over 0.9s). Never freeze a hold.
Strong torso twist with opposite head turn keeps readability of the face while the body torques.
Asymmetry everywhere: one knee up/one down, arms with different rolls.
Linear keys only; the 'ease' comes from where the keys sit in time.
manji.yuji_start.rig_note: Standard R6. Rest pose key at t=0 (all zeros) is a genuine start pose here, unlike the dummy.

manji.yuji.name: ManjiRaw
flags: poses may put limbs through the torso/head (style choice) (up to 1.2 studs): study timing/spacing/ranges/attitude; never paste or copy poses
manji.yuji.auto: 2.93s @60fps, 59 authored keys -> 56 key poses; 42% of the time is held (longest hold 0.67s); 4 snap bursts, median 216 ms, peak 12663 deg/s (punch x4.7 over the mean); torso turns 908 deg in total; torso travels 14.6 studs; biggest movers: la 520 deg, t 443 deg, ra 261 deg
manji.yuji.desc: Yuji rig, 2.93s acrobatic combo. Four ~0.2s snap bursts (peak 12.7k deg/s) separated by holds (0.2-0.67s): snap 0-0.17 | hold | snap 0.68-0.9 | hold 0.9-1.57 | long snap 1.57-2.13 | snap 2.42-2.58 | hold 2.62-2.82. Torso accumulates 908 deg of rotation, root travels 14.6 studs, arms sweep 400-500 deg. 53 of 56 key poses are linear; inside the bursts the lead joint overshoots ~30% beyond the burst's end pose.
style: Combo structure: hit - hold - hit - hold - long tumble - hit - hold; holds (0.2-0.7s) give the eye time to read each pose.
Extremes far beyond anatomy are accepted (arms 520 deg total range, torso 440 deg roll): exaggeration is the style, so go BIG and keep poses readable at the key frames.
Dense keys inside tumbles (1-2 frame gaps) so the rotation path is controlled; sparse keys in holds.
Hold = slow drift, not freeze; end on a held pose of ~0.2s.
manji.yuji.rig_note: Standard R6. Root travel and spin are carried by HumanoidRootPart/Torso keys (euler unwrap is already applied in `keys`).

cat.run.name: CatRun
cat.run.auto: 0.67s @60fps, 41 authored keys -> 29 key poses; torso travels 2.3 studs; biggest movers: ll 150 deg, rl 150 deg, t 69 deg
cat.run.desc: Cat creature rig, 0.67s looping run (Movement priority). Key on every frame (60fps), linear; reduces to 29 key poses. Legs pitch ~150 deg range each, small arm range (20 deg), torso bob 0.43 studs, travels 2.3 studs per loop, loop gap 0.0. Tail = 14 animated links (tip link static) in a side-to-side Z wave: root +-29 deg, peak +-39 deg mid-tail, 22 deg near the tip; each link lags its parent by 1 frame (16 ms). Ears +-19 deg pitch.
style: Loop is closed exactly (first = last pose, loop_gap 0).
Baked every frame with linear interpolation: smoothness comes from sampling density, not from easing.

Tail follow-through: every link repeats its parent's swing 1 frame later (16 ms): a travelling wave whose amplitude rises from the root (29 deg) to mid-tail (39 deg) and falls toward the tip (22 deg).
Run bob is small (0.4 studs): the legs do the work. Ears flap +-19 deg.
cat.run.rig_note: NOT a pure R6 rig: 17 extra joints (TailRoot, Tail2..Tail15, LEar, REar). R6 joints keep their names; the extras are stored in `ext` as joint-space raw [rx,ry,rz deg, x,y,z] (CFrame.Angles order). Use as a rhythm/timing reference, not for pose-by-pose retargeting to a humanoid.

cat.idle.name: CatIdle
cat.idle.auto: 2.67s @45fps, 121 authored keys -> 10 key poses; biggest movers: h 28 deg, ll 20 deg, t 18 deg
cat.idle.desc: Cat creature rig, 2.67s looping idle (Idle priority) at 45 fps, a key on every frame (121 keys -> 10 key poses). Very subtle: peak speed 134 deg/s, head range 28 deg, legs 20, torso 18. Tail wave: 14 links, each lagging 4 frames (88 ms), amplitude GROWING toward the tip (4 deg at the base -> 13 deg at the tip, X axis).
style: Idle = slow, smooth sine-like motion, no holds, no snaps; peak speed ~130 deg/s.
Tail lag is 4 frames per link (88 ms) at 45 fps; in the run it is 1 frame per link: the slower the motion, the larger the lag.
Tail amplitude GROWS toward the tip in the idle (4 -> 13 deg), ears move +-17 deg.
Loop closed exactly.
cat.idle.rig_note: Same creature rig as cat.run (extras in `ext`). Authored at 45 fps.
